Frequency Counter

Problem Statement:
Write a program with a generic method to count the frequency of elements in a list using a HashMap.

Description:

The program should accept n elements of any type (string or integer).

Implement a method countFrequency(List<T> list) to count and print the frequency of each element.

Use a HashMap<T, Integer> to store frequency counts.

Input Format:

First line: integer n → number of elements

Second line: n space-separated elements

Output Format:

Each unique element with its frequency
